bead.title: Add shared ADR-011 typed schema/index conformance
bead.description: Add shared conformance coverage for ADR-011 across all eligible backend families. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-conformance, backend test harnesses, pqueue tests. Scenarios: schema validation rejects before append; string/integer/float/datetime/boolean single indexes; compound indexes; missing-field sparse behavior; unique conflict atomicity on push/update_fields/replace_pending; purge removal; reopen/replay parity; name-based typed queries. Run memory and sqlite in CI; postgres remains env-gated with a clear skip when PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL is absent. Out-of-scope: new feature behavior beyond ADR-011.
bead.acceptance: cargo test -p pqueue-conformance -- --nocapture passes; cargo test -p pqueue --test secondary_indexes -- --nocapture passes; cargo test --workspace -- --nocapture passes or only documented env-gated postgres tests skip loudly.
